cases.name: gram func declare declare -p unset
cases.script: declare -p nosuch; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare declare -p declared without value
cases.script: declare d; declare -p d; declare -a e; declare -p e

cases.name: gram func declare declare -p after unset element
cases.script: a=(1 2 3); unset 'a[1]'; declare -p a

cases.name: gram func declare declare +x
cases.script: export e=1; declare +x e; declare -p e

cases.name: gram func declare declare -r then assignment
cases.script: declare -r r=1; r=2; echo status=$?; declare -p r

cases.name: gram func declare readonly listing
cases.script: readonly r1=1; readonly -p | while read -r l; do [[ $l == *r1* ]] && echo "$l"; done

cases.name: gram func declare readonly array
cases.script: readonly -a ra=(1 2); ra[0]=x; echo status=$?; declare -p ra

cases.name: gram func declare readonly unset
cases.script: readonly r=1; unset r; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare readonly without value
cases.script: readonly rv; rv=1; echo status=$?; declare -p rv

cases.name: gram func declare unset -v
cases.script: v=1; unset -v v; echo "[${v-unset}]"

cases.name: gram func declare unset several
cases.script: a=1 b=2; unset a b nosuch; echo "[${a-u}${b-u}] $?"

cases.name: gram func declare unset an invalid name
cases.script: unset 1x; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare unset a special parameter
cases.script: unset 1; echo status=$?; unset '?'; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare unset IFS default
cases.script: IFS=:; unset IFS; v='a b'; set -- $v; echo $#

cases.name: gram func declare unset PATH is fine
cases.script: unset PATH; echo still; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare export listing
cases.script: export ex1=v; export -p | while read -r l; do [[ $l == *ex1* ]] && echo "$l"; done

cases.name: gram func declare export without value
cases.script: export ev; declare -p ev; bash -c 'echo "[${ev-unset}]"'

cases.name: gram func declare export an invalid name
cases.script: export 'a-b=1'; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare export -n
cases.script: export en=1; export -n en; bash -c 'echo "[${en-unset}]"'

cases.name: gram func declare typeset -p
cases.script: typeset -i t=4; typeset -p t

cases.name: gram func declare declare conflicting options
cases.script: declare -a -A v; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare declare -u then -l
cases.script: declare -u v=abc; declare -l v; v=XyZ; echo $v

cases.name: gram func declare declare -l -u together
cases.script: declare -lu v=MiX; echo $v

cases.name: gram func declare declare -t
cases.script: declare -t tv=1; declare -p tv

cases.name: gram func declare declare with += on integer
cases.script: declare -i n=1; declare n+=4; echo $n

cases.name: gram func declare declare += on array
cases.script: a=(1); declare a+=(2); echo ${a[@]}

cases.name: gram func declare declare -g at top level
cases.script: declare -g gv=1; echo $gv

cases.name: gram func declare declare -x reaches child
cases.script: declare -x dx=1; bash -c 'echo ${dx-unset}'

cases.name: gram func declare declare in a subshell
cases.script: ( declare sd=1 ); echo "[${sd-unset}]"

cases.name: gram func declare declare invalid option
cases.script: declare -Z v; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram func declare declare name with subscript and value
cases.script: declare 'a[2]=x'; declare -p a

cases.name: gram func declare declare assignment splitting
cases.script: v='1 2'; declare -a arr=($v); declare -p arr
